fact: UN DESA states Irembo is Rwanda's national online service portal, born of a partnership between RwandaOnline Platform Ltd and the Government of Rwanda, in operation since 2015.
UN DESA states Irembo has grown to provide access to more than 90 government services online.

The Internet Society says a Karongi father renewed his family's health insurance and could request a marriage certificate copy through Rwanda's Irembo platform on his own phone, and that government initiatives are moving essential services online.
DIAL reports IremboGov is a one-stop portal for over 240 public services that citizens can access digitally and remotely.
